Oshidashi Zintrick ~ ZinTricK.summary: Oshidashi Zintrick is a Neo Geo puzzle game published in 1996. The game is comparable to a sideways version of Tetris or Columns. In this game, players hurl a pair of coloured blobs and match them with the others to make them vanish. The objective of the game is to be the last one standing. Fill your enemy’s side of the screen with blob and prevent your enemy from doing the same to you. The game features a dozen characters such as demigods, ninjas, and valkyries.
